mapper.select: SELECT OrderNo AS orderNo, OrderSeq AS orderSeq, ProductCode AS productCode, ProcessCode AS processCode, Price AS price, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, Cost AS cost, CompleteYn AS completeYn, Remark AS remark FROM OrderDetail WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND CompleteYn = 'N' ORDER BY OrderSeq

SELECT DeliveryNo AS deliveryNo, DeliverySeq AS deliverySeq, ProductCode AS productCode, ProcessCode AS processCode, Price AS price, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, Cost AS cost, OrderNo AS orderNo, OrderSeq AS orderSeq, Remark AS remark FROM DeliveryDetail WHERE DeliveryNo = #{deliveryNo} ORDER BY DeliverySeq

SELECT OrderNo AS orderNo, OrderSeq AS orderSeq, ProductCode AS productCode, ProcessCode AS processCode, Price AS price, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, Cost AS cost, CompleteYn AS completeYn, Remark AS remark FROM OrderDetail WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY OrderSeq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DeliveryMaster ( DeliveryNo, OrderDate, CustCode, Qty, Discount, Cost, BankingYn, Status, DeliveryDate, InsertDate, InsertUserID ) VALUES ( #{deliveryNo}, #{orderDate}, #{custCode}, #{qty}, #{discount}, #{cost}, #{bankingYn}, #{status}, #{deliveryDate}, GETDATE(), #{insertUserId} )

INSERT INTO DeliveryDetail ( DeliveryNo, DeliverySeq, ProductCode, ProcessCode, Price, Qty, Discount, Cost, OrderNo, OrderSeq, Remark ) VALUES
( #{deliveryDetail.deliveryNo}, #{deliveryDetail.deliverySeq}, #{deliveryDetail.productCode}, #{deliveryDetail.processCode}, #{deliveryDetail.price}, #{deliveryDetail.qty}, #{deliveryDetail.discount}, #{deliveryDetail.cost}, #{deliveryDetail.orderNo}, #{deliveryDetail.orderSeq}, #{deliveryDetail.remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OrderDetail SET Discount = #{discount}, Cost = #{cost}, CompleteYn = 'Y' WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderSeq = #{orderSeq} AND CompleteYn = 'N'
UPDATE OrderMaster SET Discount = #{discount}, Cost = #{cost}, UpdateDate = GETDATE() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo}
UPDATE OrderMaster SET Status = #{status}, CompleteYn = 'Y', DeliveryDate = GETDATE(), UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId} WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo}
